name: interaction_resource_fact
description: One row per resource leg (agent, queue, IVR, external party, dialer) of a voice interaction - the Genesys Info Mart INTERACTION_RESOURCE_FACT grain. Partitioned by call_date.

columns.name: IRF_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key of the row, unique across the run.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Interaction the leg belongs to; shared by all customer-facing legs of a call, consult legs get their own.

columns.name: ROOT_INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Interaction id of the customer call at the root of the tree; group by this to reassemble a full call including consults.

columns.name: CALL_ID
columns.description: 16-hex ConnID-style identifier of this leg, unique per row.

columns.name: CALL_DATE
columns.description: Business date of the root interaction (partition key); late legs of a call crossing midnight keep the root's date.

columns.name: SEGMENT_SEQ
columns.description: 1-based order of the leg inside the root interaction tree in creation order.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CALL_ID
columns.description: CALL_ID of the leg that led to this one (previous agent for transfers / RONA re-queues, initiating leg for consults and conferences, initiator for internal calls); null when SEGMENT_SEQ = 1.

columns.name: PARENT_INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Consult legs only: the customer interaction from which the consult was made.

columns.name: PARENT_CALL_ID
columns.description: Consult legs only: the CALL_ID of the agent leg that initiated the consult.

columns.name: RELATED_INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Callback legs only (CALLBACK_FLAG = 1): the inbound interaction in which the callback was requested.

columns.name: MEDIA_TYPE
columns.description: Always voice.

columns.name: CALL_TYPE
columns.description: Inbound | Outbound | Internal | Consult.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Resource the row describes: Agent | Queue (abandoned / callback requested, no agent) | IVR | External | Dialer.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ROLE
columns.description: Received | ReceivedTransfer | ReceivedConsult | ConferenceJoined | Initiated.

columns.name: SCENARIO
columns.description: Generator label of the scenario that produced the leg (see docs/SCENARIOS.md); not present in a real Info Mart.

columns.name: CALL_RESULT
columns.description: Business result of the leg: Answered, Abandoned, ShortAbandon, Transferred, Conferenced, RONA, SelfService, AfterHours, Voicemail, CallbackRequested, SystemError, NoAnswer, Busy, AnsweringMachine, Consulted, DialerDrop, Completed.

columns.name: CALL_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Numeric code of CALL_RESULT (1 Answered ... 17 Completed).

columns.name: TECHNICAL_RESULT
columns.description: Info Mart technical descriptor: Completed | Abandoned | Transferred | Conferenced | Redirected | Diverted | Failed.

columns.name: TECHNICAL_RESULT_REASON
columns.description: Reason detail, e.g. AnsweredByAgent, AbandonedWhileQueued, RouteOnNoAnswer, BlindTransfer, IVRContained, NoAgentAvailable.

columns.name: DISCONNECT_REASON
columns.description: Who released the leg: Customer | Agent | System | Transfer; null on RONA legs.

columns.name: DISPOSITION
columns.description: Agent wrap-up code = primary BUSINESS_RESULT in interaction_outcome_fact; Transferred / Assisted / LeftMessage on legs without an outcome; null when no agent handled a customer.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_NAME
columns.description: Dialer campaign for outbound dialer legs.

columns.name: ARRIVE_TIME
columns.description: Local start of the leg: arrival for root legs, moment of transfer / consult start / conference join / dial time otherwise.

columns.name: ARRIVE_TIME_UTC
columns.description: ARRIVE_TIME as a UTC instant.

columns.name: ANSWER_TIME
columns.description: When the resource connected (ARRIVE_TIME + IVR + QUEUE + RING); null when not answered.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: When the leg was released (ANSWER_TIME + TALK + HOLD, or arrival + IVR + queue + ring for unanswered legs).

columns.name: ACW_END_TIME
columns.description: END_TIME + ACW_TIME; null when ACW_TIME = 0.

columns.name: IVR_TIME
columns.description: Seconds in IVR / announcement / voicemail before queuing.

columns.name: QUEUE_TIME
columns.description: Seconds waiting in the VQ (time waited before hanging up for abandons; dialer hand-off delay for dialer legs).

columns.name: RING_TIME
columns.description: Seconds the target resource was alerting (25 on RONA legs).

columns.name: TALK_TIME
columns.description: Seconds connected excluding hold (conference initiators include the conference portion).

columns.name: HOLD_TIME
columns.description: Seconds the customer was on hold, including consult time for legs that consulted.

columns.name: HOLD_COUNT
columns.description: Number of holds.

columns.name: ACW_TIME
columns.description: After-call work seconds.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: END_TIME - ARRIVE_TIME in seconds (excludes ACW).

columns.name: HANDLE_TIME
columns.description: TALK_TIME + HOLD_TIME + ACW_TIME.

columns.name: INTERVAL_15MIN
columns.description: ARRIVE_TIME floored to the 15-minute interval (local).

columns.name: ARRIVE_HOUR
columns.description: Local hour of ARRIVE_TIME (0-23).

columns.name: ROUTE_POINT
columns.description: Route point DN the call entered on (the original VQ's for overflowed calls); null for direct DID / manual outbound / internal.

columns.name: DNIS
columns.description: Number dialled: VQ DNIS for inbound, agent DID for direct / consult / internal, customer number for outbound.

columns.name: ANI
columns.description: Calling number: customer ANI for inbound, site CLI (or VQ DNIS for callbacks) for outbound, initiating agent id for consults, agent DID for internal.

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: ACD queue DN behind the VQ.

columns.name: QUEUE_NAME
columns.description: ACD queue name.

columns.name: VQ_ID
columns.description: Virtual queue id.

columns.name: VQ_NAME
columns.description: Virtual queue the leg was distributed from / worked in (the queue that finally handled an overflowed call); null for direct DID, manual outbound, internal, external legs.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_VQ_NAME
columns.description: Set when the call overflowed: the VQ the customer originally queued in.

columns.name: SKILL
columns.description: Skill expression of the VQ.

columns.name: ROUTING_METHOD
columns.description: How the resource was selected: ACD | PBR | Direct | Consult | Conference | Manual | Dialer | Internal | Callback; queue legs carry the VQ's ACD/PBR; null on IVR / external legs.

columns.name: PBR_SCORE
columns.description: PBR-routed agent legs only: the selected agent's PBR percentile score (0-1).

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: Agent employee id; null on Queue / IVR / External / Dialer legs.

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: Agent display name.

columns.name: AGENT_GROUP
columns.description: Team, {LOB}_{SITE}_TEAMnn.

columns.name: SITE
columns.description: Agent's site, or the VQ's home site when no agent handled the leg; null for IVR self-service and external legs.

columns.name: LOB
columns.description: Line of business of the VQ (or of the agent for direct / outbound / internal).

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer key; null on consult and internal legs.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SEGMENT
columns.description: Consumer | SMB | Enterprise | VIP.

columns.name: ANSWERED_FLAG
columns.description: Resource connected (has ANSWER_TIME).

columns.name: ABANDON_FLAG
columns.description: Customer hung up before an agent connected (in queue or while ringing) or the dialer dropped the customer.

columns.name: SHORT_ABANDON_FLAG
columns.description: Abandoned with QUEUE_TIME below short_abandon_threshold_s; excluded from service level.

columns.name: RONA_FLAG
columns.description: Agent was alerted and did not answer (Redirect On No Answer).

columns.name: OVERFLOW_FLAG
columns.description: Call was rerouted from ORIGINAL_VQ_NAME to VQ_NAME after waiting overflow_wait_s.

columns.name: TRANSFER_FLAG
columns.description: This leg ended by transferring the customer onwards.

columns.name: TRANSFER_IN_FLAG
columns.description: This leg received the customer via a transfer.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TYPE
columns.description: Blind | Warm | External, on both the transferring and the receiving leg.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO
columns.description: On the transferring leg: target VQ name, target agent id or external number.

columns.name: TRANSFER_COUNT
columns.description: Transfers that occurred in the interaction before this leg began.

columns.name: CONFERENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Leg took part in a conference (initiator and joined agent).

columns.name: CONSULT_FLAG
columns.description: Agent on this leg initiated a consult (warm transfer, consult-only, conference set-up).

columns.name: CONSULT_RECEIVED_FLAG
columns.description: This is the consult leg itself (CALL_TYPE = Consult).

columns.name: CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.description: Outbound leg fulfilling a requested callback.

columns.name: CALLBACK_REQUESTED_FLAG
columns.description: Inbound queue leg on which the customer accepted a callback offer.

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: 1 when QUEUE_TIME + RING_TIME <= the VQ's service_level_s, 0 otherwise; null when not applicable (short abandons, callbacks, direct / warm-received / consult / outbound legs).

columns.name: FIRST_CALL_FLAG
columns.description: First contact of this customer in the generated period.

columns.name: REPEAT_CALL_7D_FLAG
columns.description: Customer had another contact in the previous 7 days.

columns.name: N_AGENT
columns.description: Agent parties on the leg: 0, 1 or 2 (consult, conference, internal).

columns.name: N_CUSTOMER
columns.description: Customer parties on the leg: 1 for customer-facing legs and connected outbound, else 0.

name: interaction_outcome_fact
description: Business outcomes recorded on handled customer legs (sale, saved, cancelled, resolved, payment, no change ...): one primary outcome per leg plus optional CrossSell secondary. Join to interaction_resource_fact on IRF_ID. Partitioned by call_date.

columns.name: OUTCOME_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key, unique across the run.

columns.name: IRF_ID
columns.description: The agent leg the outcome was recorded on (interaction_resource_fact.IRF_ID).

columns.name: CALL_ID
columns.description: CALL_ID of that leg.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: INTERACTION_ID of that leg.

columns.name: ROOT_INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: ROOT_INTERACTION_ID of that leg (whole-call grouping key).

columns.name: CALL_DATE
columns.description: CALL_DATE of that leg (partition key).

columns.name: OUTCOME_SEQ
columns.description: 1 = primary outcome (equals the leg's DISPOSITION), 2 = secondary CrossSell.

columns.name: OUTCOME_TIME
columns.description: When the outcome happened: inside the conversation for monetary outcomes (and in_call_event_prob of the others), otherwise at wrap-up; always >= the leg's ANSWER_TIME.

columns.name: OUTCOME_TIME_UTC
columns.description: OUTCOME_TIME as a UTC instant.

columns.name: RECORDED_TIME
columns.description: When the agent coded the outcome: inside the ACW window (END_TIME..ACW_END_TIME) or at END_TIME when there is no ACW; always >= OUTCOME_TIME.

columns.name: IN_CALL_FLAG
columns.description: 1 when OUTCOME_TIME lies inside the talk (<= END_TIME).

columns.name: CALL_TYPE
columns.description: CALL_TYPE of the leg.

columns.name: SCENARIO
columns.description: SCENARIO of the leg.

columns.name: LOB
columns.description: LOB whose outcome catalogue was used (VQ's LOB, or the agent's LOB for direct / manual outbound).

columns.name: VQ_NAME
columns.description: VQ_NAME of the leg.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_NAME
columns.description: Dialer campaign of the leg, if any.

columns.name: ROUTING_METHOD
columns.description: ROUTING_METHOD of the leg (ACD, PBR, Direct, Manual, Dialer, Callback).

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: Agent who recorded the outcome (= the leg's agent).

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: Agent display name.

columns.name: AGENT_GROUP
columns.description: Agent team.

columns.name: AGENT_TENURE_BAND
columns.description: Agent tenure band.

columns.name: AGENT_PBR_SCORE
columns.description: The agent's PBR percentile score (0-1) on every row regardless of routing method; the agent effect on outcomes is driven by the same latent quality.

columns.name: SITE
columns.description: Agent site.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer key.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SEGMENT
columns.description: Consumer | SMB | Enterprise | VIP.

columns.name: QUEUE_TIME
columns.description: QUEUE_TIME of the leg (seconds), for wait-effect analysis without a join.

columns.name: TALK_TIME
columns.description: TALK_TIME of the leg (seconds).

columns.name: HANDLE_TIME
columns.description: HANDLE_TIME of the leg (seconds).

columns.name: OUTCOME_CATEGORY
columns.description: Roll-up: Sale | Retention | Churn | Service | Escalation | Billing | Collections | FollowUp | NoChange.

columns.name: BUSINESS_RESULT
columns.description: The outcome code from the LOB catalogue (Sale, NoSale, Saved, Cancelled, Downgraded, OfferDeclined, NoChange, Resolved, Escalated, FollowUp, PaymentTaken, PromiseToPay ...) or CrossSell on secondary rows.

columns.name: OUTCOME_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Detail: product sold, save offer, cancel reason, resolution type, payment method, escalation target, cross-sell product; null when the outcome has no subtypes.

columns.name: OUTCOME_POLARITY
columns.description: Positive | Neutral | Negative.

columns.name: OFFER_MADE_FLAG
columns.description: An offer was presented to the customer.

columns.name: AMOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Revenue | MRR_Retained | MRR_Lost | Payment | Credit | Promise; null when the outcome carries no money.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Positive amount in CURRENCY (direction given by AMOUNT_TYPE); present iff AMOUNT_TYPE.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: ISO currency code of AMOUNT (outcomes.currency).

columns.name: FOLLOW_UP_FLAG
columns.description: A case / task was created (scheduled callback, pending decision, escalation, dispute, dispatch, promise to pay, hardship referral).

columns.name: CASE_ID
columns.description: Case / ticket id, present iff FOLLOW_UP_FLAG.

columns.name: FOLLOW_UP_DUE_TIME
columns.description: When the follow-up is due (1-5 days after RECORDED_TIME at a business hour; 3-14 days for promises to pay).

columns.name: SITE
columns.description: Site name (primary key; joins interaction_resource_fact.SITE, dim_agent.SITE, dim_vq.HOME_SITE).

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: ISO country code of the site.

columns.name: OFFSHORE_FLAG
columns.description: 1 for offshore sites, which staff most night shifts.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_CLI
columns.description: Caller id presented on outbound calls from this site (ANI of outbound legs).

columns.name: LOB
columns.description: Line of business name (primary key; joins LOB on both facts, dim_vq.LOB, dim_agent.LOB).

columns.name: LOB_SHORT
columns.description: Short code used in AGENT_GROUP names (SAL, RET, CS, TEC, BIL, COL).

name: dim_vq
description: Virtual queues with their ACD queue, route point, DNIS, opening hours, routing method and expected AHT.

columns.name: VQ_ID
columns.description: Virtual queue id (primary key; joins interaction_resource_fact.VQ_ID).

columns.name: VQ_NAME
columns.description: Virtual queue name (joins VQ_NAME / ORIGINAL_VQ_NAME / TRANSFER_TO on the fact).

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: ACD queue DN behind the VQ.

columns.name: QUEUE_NAME
columns.description: ACD queue name.

columns.name: ROUTE_POINT
columns.description: Route point DN calls to this VQ enter on.

columns.name: DNIS
columns.description: Toll-free number dialled to reach this VQ.

columns.name: LOB
columns.description: Line of business of the VQ.

columns.name: SKILL
columns.description: Skill expression required to take calls from the VQ.

columns.name: HOME_SITE
columns.description: Site reported on queue legs that never reached an agent.

columns.name: OPEN_HOUR
columns.description: Local opening hour (0-23).

columns.name: CLOSE_HOUR
columns.description: Local closing hour (1-24; 24 = midnight; OPEN 0 / CLOSE 24 = 24x7).

columns.name: OPEN_DAYS
columns.description: Mon-Sun | Mon-Sat | Mon-Fri.

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_S
columns.description: Service-level threshold in seconds used for SERVICE_LEVEL_FLAG.

columns.name: OVERFLOW_VQ_NAME
columns.description: Backup VQ calls overflow to after overflow_wait_s; null when none.

columns.name: ROUTING_METHOD
columns.description: ACD (longest idle, uniform) or PBR (Predictive Behavioural Routing, skewed to high-scoring agents).

columns.name: PBR_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: 1 when the VQ uses PBR.

columns.name: PBR_SKEW
columns.description: Strength of the PBR skew: agent selection weight = exp(PBR_SKEW * agent quality z-score), i.e. the log-normal sigma of agent weights (0 = uniform, 1.2 = extreme); null for ACD queues.

columns.name: ROSTER_SIZE
columns.description: Number of agents skilled for the VQ (primary or secondary skill).

columns.name: EXPECTED_AHT_S
columns.description: Expected average handle time in seconds used for staffing (talk + expected hold + ACW).

name: dim_agent
description: Agent roster: team, site, LOB, skills, shift, days off, personal speed factor and PBR score.

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: Agent employee id (primary key; joins AGENT_ID on both facts and TRANSFER_TO).

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: Display name.

columns.name: AGENT_GROUP
columns.description: Team, {LOB}_{SITE}_TEAMnn.

columns.name: SITE
columns.description: Site the agent works from.

columns.name: LOB
columns.description: Line of business of the agent's primary skill.

columns.name: AGENT_TENURE_BAND
columns.description: <3m | 3-12m | 1-3y | 3y+; newer agents are slower and have lower PBR quality on average.

columns.name: PRIMARY_VQ_NAME
columns.description: VQ of the agent's primary skill.

columns.name: SKILLS
columns.description: Pipe-separated skill expressions the agent carries (primary plus optional secondary in the same LOB).

columns.name: SHIFT_START_HOUR
columns.description: Local hour the agent's shift starts (0-23).

columns.name: SHIFT_LEN_H
columns.description: Shift length in hours.

columns.name: DAYS_OFF
columns.description: Pipe-separated weekday names the agent does not work.

columns.name: SPEED_FACTOR
columns.description: Multiplier on the agent's talk and ACW times (1.0 = average).

columns.name: PBR_SCORE
columns.description: Percentile rank (0-1) of the agent's latent quality; drives PBR routing and the agent effect on business outcomes.

columns.name: AGENT_DID
columns.description: Agent's direct-dial number (DNIS of direct / consult / internal legs).

name: dim_customer
description: Customer pool: id, phone number (ANI) and segment.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer key (primary key; joins CUSTOMER_ID on both facts).

columns.name: ANI
columns.description: Customer phone number (ANI of inbound legs, DNIS of outbound legs).

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SEGMENT
columns.description: Consumer | SMB | Enterprise | VIP.
